description:
The keyword-stuffing guard, aimed at this exact resume. Every single requirement appears in resume.md's ## SKILLS line and in NO ## EXPERIENCE or ## PROJECTS bullet: RAG concepts, n8n, data modeling, advanced Excel, REST APIs. Under the demonstrated-vs-listed rule ported in 018A, a term whose only home is a skills list is an unproven claim, so this must NOT score as a strong match even though a substring matcher would find every keyword.

The JD is deliberately long enough to grade 'full'. Its first version was 484 characters, which jd_grade calls 'incomplete' -- and the prompt tells the model to judge those on title and function alone. It scored 65 and its reason opened 'Incomplete posting'. The fixture was testing the teaser path, not the rule it was written for. A fixture whose JD does not grade 'full' cannot test scoring.
source: constructed to target resume.md's listed-only terms

job.title: Senior AI Data Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

We are hiring a Senior AI Data Engineer in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia to own our retrieval and reporting stack end to end.

Key Responsibilities
- Own production Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems: corpus chunking strategy, embedding model selection, retrieval evaluation harnesses, and reranking, running at enterprise scale
- Operate and extend n8n workflow automation: build, version, monitor and debug production automation workflows used daily by business teams
- Design and maintain dimensional warehouse models: star schemas, slowly changing dimensions, conformed dimensions, and governed semantic layers
- Build advanced Excel financial models and reporting workbooks for finance stakeholders, including scenario analysis
- Design, version and document REST APIs consumed by several downstream teams

Qualifications
- Demonstrated production experience operating RAG systems at scale, not familiarity with the concepts
- Demonstrated production n8n workflow automation experience
- Demonstrated dimensional data modeling experience: star schemas and slowly changing dimensions in a live warehouse
- Advanced Excel modelling for finance stakeholders
- REST API design and versioning across multiple consumer teams
- Track record of owning the above in production, evidenced by shipped work rather than by a skills list

Nice to Have
- Experience presenting warehouse models to non-technical stakeholders
